entries.en: Leaving behind the lingering sound, holding the sword, dancing in the dream and singing.
entries.ja: Leaving behind the lingering sound, holding the sword, dancing in the dream and singing.

entries.zhHans:
机关变转之刻，余音回响不绝。风带来了新的讯息，也带来了久违的重逢。
神机锋刃挥下，云雀褪去初羽。少女随歌而行，于梦中所见的，是她那不再停滞的命运。
entries.en:
When the gears shifted, the echoes of the music continued to reverberate. The wind brought new messages and also long-awaited reunions.
With the swift motion of the divine blade, the lark shed its initial feathers. The young girl followed the melody, and what she saw in her dream was her destiny that no longer stood still.
